content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed natural-gas distribution operations service (regulator/segment design + meter readings + leak/pressure reporting) as an auditable, open-source reference implementation.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native natural-gas distribution primitives open to any AT Protocol client.

content.findings: Topology = directed regulator → service-point edges with MAOP enforcement. Class-1 leaks emit immediate emergency notice; pressure-over-MAOP triggers regulator audit.
content.recommendations: Add SCADA realtime ingest, cathodic-protection module, and odorant-level (mercaptan) audit per safety regulation.
